thread:
alex-sdr: ACME POC blocked in demo at 3pm. After rotating keys they get `401 invalid_key` when they include X-Redwood-Org and X-Redwood-Project. Without headers the old secret sometimes still works. Can we triage before the customer demo at 4?

jordan-eng: Paste the sanitized curl and last 6-8 chars of the key id please.

alex-sdr: They sent this sanitized curl:
```
curl -s -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED-c4d2" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-enterprise" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Project: demo-app" \
  -d '{"prompt":"status"}'
```
Response: `401 {"error":{"code":"invalid_key","message":"key not valid for requested org"}}`

mica-platform: Looking up key suffix `c4d2` shows this secret is a user-scoped key created in a personal workspace. Auth rules now enforce that requests with X-Redwood-Org must be served by org-scoped keys. We tightened this after an auth hardening change last release.

sam-se: Two immediate paths: 1) create an org-scoped key in their Console and rotate server secret (recommended), or 2) remove X-Redwood-Org for a quick demo (not recommended for production).

alex-sdr: Customer says they sometimes see 429s when retrying. Could rotation be causing quota spikes?

jordan-eng: Possibly. If they rapidly retry or stomp multiple pods with new keys you can quickly hit org quotas and see `429 Too Many Requests`. Also project-scoped vs org-scoped keys count to different quota buckets; switching can change rate limits. Check Console usage after the rotation attempt.

security-bot: Note: sending org keys to client-side is disallowed. Org keys must remain server-side. If their frontend has keys exposed, we should escalate.

mica-platform: Also check for mixed rollout: if some pods use old personal key and some use new org key, headers will behave inconsistently. We saw a similar issue where k8s secret rollout was partial. Run `kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].env}'` to confirm env values.

alex-sdr: They do use k8s secrets and a CI pipeline that rolls gradually. Might be mixed.

sam-se: I can spin up an ephemeral org key for the demo so they can validate cleanly during the call. Will create 12h ephemeral with generate+embeddings.

jordan-eng: Also verify scopes: if the key is created with "generate-only" preset then `/v1/embeddings` will return `403 insufficient_scope`. Ask which endpoints they call.

alex-sdr: They call both generate and embeddings.

billing-bot: Reminder: org keys apply to org quotas and billing. If they test heavily during the demo it could incur noticeable usage; recommend monitoring Console and enabling alerts. Billing team can provide a rough Dedicated burst cost estimate if they ask.

security-bot: Customer also attached a security questionnaire asking: "How are API secrets stored and rotated?" We should send our standard answer: store server-side in secret manager (K8s secrets/Vault), restrict access via IAM, rotate via CI with atomic rollout, and revoke old keys after validation.

mica-platform: Created ephemeral org key `sk-org-demo-temp-91a2` (12h expiry). Validated both endpoints with headers; both return 200. Sending via secure channel now.

alex-sdr: Scheduling 30-min demo rescue in 20m. Can someone join to walk rotation and k8s restart?

jordan-eng: I'll join. Quick checklist for the call to unblock them:
- Confirm key id suffix and binding in our system
- Run quick endpoint tests with ephemeral key (generate + embeddings)
- If intermittent, restart pods to ensure no mixed secrets
- After validation, create a permanent org key in Console with required scopes and roll atomically
- Revoke old personal keys

sam-se: Also remind them not to send org headers from client-side code; server should add headers when proxying requests.

alex-sdr: Post-call update: we used the ephemeral key to validate and then created a permanent org key for them. They had mixed pods; a full restart fixed intermittent 401s. Embeddings were previously failing due to scope preset (`generate-only`) and we recreated the org key with both scopes. Billing asked for a short estimate for a one-month Dedicated burst; looping finance. Demo succeeded. Closing this thread unless anything else appears.

jordan-eng: :thumbsup: I'll attach the short one-pager on key best practices and the troubleshooting checklist to the ticket.
